add_new_tokens_to_model: add new tokens to a model and tokenizer using mean or interpolation method for embedding initialization
fix_untrained_tokens_in_model: fix untrained token embeddings in a model by replacing them with the mean of trained tokens
patch_tokenizer_pad_token: patch a tokenizer to set a proper pad token when the model lacks one or pad equals eos
patch_processor_call_for_vision: patch a vision model processor to auto-apply chat template when conversation format is passed as text
compute_mean_of_trained_tokens: compute the mean embedding and lm head vectors across all trained tokens excluding untrained ones
